rules.statement: Each vendor is liable only for a proportionate share of the damages in an action for eviction where they sell their undivided shares.
rules.supporting_quote: "Clearly, if the plurality of vendors did not sell communiter, but each only his own undivided share of what had been possessed by him pro indiviso, then as there are considered to be as many sales as shares sold, there is no doubt but that each is bound only for his own share, not only in respect to making good the damages sustained by the eviction, but also in respect to undertaking the defence".
